# DOCX File

## Summary
The FileDef specialization for Word documents (OOXML `.docx`).
An instance is an uploaded realm file with card semantics: the binary lives at
the file URL while the card carries extracted metadata and renders with
format-aware templates.

## Shape
Extends `FileDef`. Adds `officeMetadata` (`OfficeMetadataField`) and overrides `extractAttributes` to read the
OOXML package on upload — author, title, revision and word counts come from
`docProps` rather than the byte stream. Carries a `previewComponent`, so the
document routes to the shared document preview.

Accepts: `.docx, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document`

## Example
```ts
import { DocxDef } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/docx-file-def';

@field attachment = linksTo(DocxDef);
```
Instances are created by upload (`createFileDef` wires the type from the
MIME type). Live examples need uploaded fixtures — `Spec` has no field that
accepts a file today (`linkedExamples` is `linksToMany(CardDef)`, and
`FileDef` is a sibling of `CardDef`), so the example check stays open for
every file def until `fileExamples` lands.
